title: ConsentHistory
description: plinth.consent_history/1, from api.consent_history() (API_CONTRACTS §3.2; DESIGN §5b Rohan's consent history). Every consent the buyer gave, newest first, each by its C-MMDD-NN ref. Identical on web and app. Refs, dates and counts come from the ledger rows; party and detail are what the buyer saw at the tap.

count_line.description: Distinct parties holding the number now, as in WhoHasMyNumber.

purpose_line.description: The purpose as the privacy notice words it.

notice_version.description: The privacy notice version shown at the tap.

number_shared.description: The party can see the number now (a live share made by the buyer's tap).

access_until.description: Last day of a live number share; null when it has no end or the number is not shared.

ended_on.description: The day the consent ended or was withdrawn; null while active.

can_withdraw.description: True until withdrawn; api.consent_withdraw(ref) withdraws it.

relay.description: The WhatsApp relay this consent backs, if any. Pass relay_id to api.relay_renew.

ConsentRelay.title: ConsentRelay
ConsentRelay.description: A WhatsApp text relay instead of the number. It never counts toward the cap.

closes_on.description: When an open relay closes (null while a deal is active and no end is set), or the day a closed one closed.

counts_toward_cap.description: Always false: a relay is not a number holder.
